product.description: Evaluează-ţi cunoştinţele de istoria lumii şi călătoreşte de-a lungul a 5 500 de ani plini de evenimente importante pentru om. De la primele civilizaţii şi imperii, treci la străvechile lumi din Orientul Mijlociu şi din Africa, la veacul de aur al Indiei şi la dinastiile Chinei.Află despre fondarea Romei şi a republicii romane, despre culturile din Peru şi despre Evul Mediu, însoţeşte-i pe cavalerii medievali în cruciade şi priveşte Imperiul Otoman în expansiunea sa, pentru a ajunge în cele din urmă la cele două războaie mondiale care au zguduit secolul XX.Cu întrebări cu răspuns multiplu, hărţi şi fotografii, această carte stimulantă şi instructivă îţi va testa bagajul de cunoştinţe şi, în egală măsură, te va amuza.

content: # 1000 Questions and Answers: A Journey Through World History Dive deep into human civilization with **1000 Questions and Answers: The History of the World**. This comprehensive quiz book is designed to challenge your knowledge while transporting you across millennia. If you are passionate about history, this resource will test your understanding of major events, influential figures, and groundbreaking cultures throughout timeâmaking learning both stimulating and fun! ## Explore 5,500 Years of Human Civilization From the earliest human settlements to the pivotal moments of the modern era, this book takes you on an epic journey through global history. You will navigate significant periods and civilizations that shaped the world we know today. **What historical eras are covered?** The scope of World History in this volume is vast, ensuring no major period is overlooked: * **Ancient Foundations:** Trace your knowledge back to the first great civilizations and empires, including pivotal details about ancient Peru and the rise of Roman culture and the Republic. * **Classical Empires:** Explore the grandeur of established powers, from mastering the expansion of the Ottoman Empire to understanding the founding myths of Rome. * **Asian Dynasties & Cultures:** Journey through the golden age of India and the powerful dynasties of China, examining distinct cultural milestones. * **The Medieval World:** Follow the tales of medieval knights and delve into the dramatic events surrounding the Crusades. * **Modern Conflicts:** Conclude your educational trek by mastering the complexities of the two world wars that defined the 20th century. ## How Will You Test Your Knowledge? This is more than just a book of facts; it's an interactive learning experience built for maximum retention and fun. Each question utilizes various formats to keep you engaged: * **Multiple-Choice Questions:** Test your breadth of knowledge with engaging multiple-choice quizzes. * **Detailed Maps & Photography:** Enhance your learning through accompanying maps and photographs that bring historical locations vividly to life. * **Stimulating Format:** The blend of questions, answers, visual aids, and narrative depth ensures that reviewing World History feels like an adventure rather than a chore. ## Product Details * **Title:** 1000 Questions and Answers: The History of the World * **Brand:** Litera * **Category:** Books * **Price:** 29.99 *** ### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **Q: Is this book suitable for beginners or experts?** A: The quiz format is designed to be engaging for history enthusiasts of all levels. While it covers complex topics, the multiple-choice structure makes it accessible and fun regardless of your prior knowledge. **Q: Does the book provide study materials only, or is it a test?** A: This resource combines both elements. It tests your current understanding while providing foundational information structured around key historical events and civilizations. Buy Now and Begin Your Journey Through World History (29.99) *** World History, History Quiz Book, Ancient Civilizations, Roman Empire, Medieval History, World War II, Educational Books, Litera, Geography Quizzes, Global History
